title: Kestrel and the Bell
author: Noor Ishikawa
blurb: Cyrus Marchetti, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
